# AI Wise

> AI Wise is the one-person practice of Simon van Meegdenburg. He uses AI to
> build apps, websites, tools and agents, ideally for organisations doing work
> that matters. Many of them take over repetitive work.
> Tagline: Automation in Service of Life.

The website is a single page in Dutch and English. It gives examples, describes
what has become possible, offers the free AI Opportunity Scan, introduces Simon and
explains how to get in touch. It deliberately carries no service catalogue and no
pricing; the free scan is its one offer.

## What has changed

Having a website, app or tool built has become far more attainable. AI shortens
the path from an idea to a working system, and what used to be a major project
is now manageable. That opens the door for small businesses and organisations
doing meaningful work.

## The free AI Opportunity Scan

An hour-long conversation about the opportunities for the business, whether
the client has not touched AI yet, has already been experimenting with it or
has an idea to build on. Afterwards the client receives the Opportunity Brief
(Dutch: Kansenschets), describing a sensible next step they can take
themselves. No strings attached. The scan is free; the site names no price for
anything after it. It is booked by WhatsApp.

## Examples

The website gives these as examples of what is possible, to think with. They
are not a service catalogue.

- A searchable archive of WhatsApp chats, voice messages included.
- A modernised website.
- Everything a client sent, by email or WhatsApp, in one overview.
- A webshop or online teaching space alongside an in-person offering.
- Participants who manage their own bookings or memberships.
- Meeting notes processed automatically.
- An agent that takes over the most tedious task.

## About Simon

- He has been building data systems since 2018, first as a BI consultant and
  later as a data engineer.
- He builds websites and apps, from design to a working product.
- He knows what it takes to build a system ready for everyday use.
- He is happiest building for organisations that serve the public good.
- With AI, he can turn an idea into a first prototype in about a day.

## What the website does not include

- No pricing, packages or scope beyond the free scan.
- No case studies, client names or testimonials, because none are confirmed for
  public use.
- No claims about time saved, safety or privacy outcomes.

## Contact

The site invites anyone with a question, an idea or work that keeps coming back,
even if it is not fully thought through yet.

Contact runs through a contact form on the site, which sends the message to
Simon's inbox via Formward, an EU-based form service. He can also be reached by
email at simon@aiwise.it.com or by WhatsApp on +31 6 13926494.

## Crawling

Regular search crawlers, AI search and discovery crawlers, and user-triggered
fetchers are welcome to read and cite this site. Model-training crawlers are
disallowed in robots.txt; that is a deliberate and separate choice from being
findable in AI-assisted search.
